description: Fetch one Form 4 filing by its exact SEC accession number (format NNNNNNNNNN-YY-NNNNNN, e.g. 0000320193-26-000001). Use this once you already have an accession number from get_recent_filings or get_transactions. Returns filed/period-of-report dates, company and insider identity, and transaction count for that filing. Free plan.

accession.description: SEC accession number in NNNNNNNNNN-YY-NNNNNN format (10-digit filer CIK, 2-digit year, 6-digit sequence), e.g. 0000320193-26-000001. Copy this from a get_recent_filings or get_transactions result.

name: get_filing
